scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
Imported coverage is 1492 to 1500 in northwestern Venezuela. Neither date is used as a founding or extinction date. Modern observations are not projected back into the fifteenth century.
Añú, Añuu and Paraujano identify this entry. It is not merged with Wayuu records. A linguistic relationship does not establish a shared political entity.
The 2006 educational work reports earlier field research. Its settlement and livelihood descriptions are not a 2026 census or an assertion of universal practice.

The architecture claim uses the thesis’s printed page 92, PDF page 96. Material construction is distinguished from the author’s wider philosophical interpretation. No claim is made to have read every chapter.
The 1996 kinship source was consulted through its abstract and indexed first page. The full article was not accessed.
The UNICEF evaluation is dated December 2001, not 2003. Reported word and story totals measure documentation, not successful restoration of everyday fluency.
The 2009 linguistic assessment is historical. The card does not declare the present language extinct or assert a current speaker count.
The 2024 school caption was available as indexed text. The direct PDF returned an access error, and neither the photograph nor its full report was inspected.
No unverified conquest, founder, archaeological culture or successor is supplied. Independent historical review and depth certification remain pending.
